ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 70% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white central zone extending to 90% of the lobe height. Low-intensity black banding and mottling form a continuous boundary along the trailing edge and concentrate into dense regions near the peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and pixel-amplitude on the right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex geometric curve from the notch to the distal tips; the leading edge sweep is partially occluded by water-surface turbulence.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-pixel clusters and circular disruptions visible in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe; prominent textured dark masses (barnacles) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multidirectional, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated around the median notch and lower lobe centers.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant hypertrophic texture/protrusions at the distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization; dense parallel linear scarring across the lower-central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, solid-black pigmentation focal point located on the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
